H-readout-invalid.basis: oracle-null separation, null flatness in P, coverage and replica gates on the decision-tick readout

H-avoidance-untrained.basis: AGENT at P_train vs the derived bar, on a validated instrument

H-env-band-absent.basis: the quantile SAFE bin supplies >= MIN_BIN_COVERAGE_TICKS EXECUTABLE decision ticks per cell (wall-clamped ticks recorded separately)

preconditions.name: hazard_field_replica_matches_obs
preconditions.description: max |hazard_field_view[12] - env.hazard_field[agent cell]/max| over every step of every arm -- the quantile bins are taken from env.hazard_field, so it must be the quantity the agent observes
preconditions.control: env's own field, normalised exactly as the view is

preconditions.name: high_bin_decision_ticks_covered
preconditions.description: min over (seed, level) of the CONTROL arms' HIGH-bin DECISION ticks (non-negotiables (3)/(4)); the AGENT arm is gated separately (red-team F7)
preconditions.control: quantile bins on the env's own field distribution

preconditions.name: safe_bin_executable_decision_ticks_covered
preconditions.description: min over (seed, level) of the CONTROL arms' SAFE-bin DECISION ticks whose designated avoidant action is EXECUTABLE (not a wall no-op) -- the H-env-band-absent leg; the false-alarm rate is scored over these ticks only; the AGENT arm is gated separately (red-team F7)
preconditions.control: quantile SAFE bin, wall-clamped ticks excluded

preconditions.name: oracle_null_separation
preconditions.description: worst (seed, level) of CONDITIONAL_ORACLE minus HAZARD_BLIND_NULL decision-tick sensitivity -- the instrument can register threat-gated avoidance (non-negotiable (2))
preconditions.control: measured positive and negative control arms on the same env, seed and decision schedule

preconditions.name: decision_schedule_matches_P
preconditions.description: AGENT realised decision ticks / (steps / P), every (seed, level): must sit within 1 +/- SCHEDULE_TOL -- the forced period IS the agent's schedule only if no MECH-091 phase reset fires (red-team F1, BLOCKING in the first draft)

preconditions.name: agent_high_bin_decision_ticks_covered
preconditions.description: min over (seed, level) of the AGENT's HIGH-bin decision ticks -- an avoider that never enters HIGH is classed agent_starves_high_bin, not instrument

preconditions.name: agent_safe_bin_executable_decision_ticks_covered
preconditions.description: min over (seed, level) of the AGENT's executable SAFE-bin decision ticks -- classed agent_starves_safe_bin when only the agent starves

preconditions.name: null_sensitivity_flat_in_P_RECORDED
preconditions.description: range across the 5 levels of the null's mean decision-tick sensitivity -- decision-tick scoring must remove the hold-period confound (999 red-team F2: the all-step null was monotone in P)
preconditions.control: hazard-blind null across P; RECORDED ONLY (red-team F5: tautologically flat in expectation, fails by noise)

preconditions.name: baseline_avoidance_clears_derived_bar
preconditions.description: mean over seeds of AGENT sensitivity at P_train minus [null + BAR_FRACTION*(oracle - null)] at P_train, decision ticks -- the DERIVED positive control replacing 999's hand-picked +0.05 (H-avoidance-untrained if unmet with a valid instrument)
preconditions.control: bar derived from the measured oracle/null separation at the same P

preconditions.name: dv_headroom_interior_margin
preconditions.dv_name: raw (oracle - null) decision-tick separation per level -- the instrument's dynamic range the normalised C1 margin is scaled by
preconditions.headroom_reason: DV headroom met: raw (oracle - null) decision-tick separation per level -- the instrument's dynamic range the normalised C1 margin is scaled by can reach 0.760634 (floor_headroom over 5 finite value(s); cells: P5, P8, P10, P15, P20), against a required 0.06 (criterion threshold 0.03 x margin 2).

criteria.name: C1_interior_max_margin_normalised
criteria.description: On s_norm(P) = (agent - null)/(oracle - null) at decision ticks, mean over seeds: the level with maximum mean s_norm is INTERIOR and beats both extreme levels by >= max(MARGIN_ABS_FLOOR_NORM, MARGIN_SD_MULT * pooled cross-seed SD).

combination_rule: PASS = every readiness gate green AND DV moved (normalised range >= floor) AND C1. A red gate routes by readiness_failure_class (instrument -> substrate_not_ready_requeue; avoidance_untrained -> H-avoidance-untrained supported, MECH-161 untested; env_band_absent -> H-env-band-absent supported). MECH-161 direction is set only when ready and non-degenerate.

claim_scope.what_this_run_measures: The SHAPE premise only: an operating-point sweep of the forced E3 period on a frozen trained agent, with MECH-093's regulator output overwritten each tick. MECH-161's REGULATOR assertion is NOT tested (autopsy Section 5); MECH-026's regulator is unbuilt.
